name: Take-off and hover
brief: Lift off, climb into the ring and hold it steady. Then land gently back on the pad.

steps.text: Climb into the ring and hold steady
Land back on the pad

name: Nose-in hover
brief: Turn the drone to face you and hold. Left and right are now reversed on the right stick.

steps.text: Take off and climb to 3 m
Yaw until the nose faces you, then hold
Land back on the pad

name: Side-on hovers
brief: Hold with the nose pointing to your right, then to your left. Forward stick now moves the drone sideways.

steps.text: Take off and climb to 3 m
Point the nose to your right and hold
Now point the nose to your left and hold
Land back on the pad

name: Box pattern
brief: Fly a 20 m square through the four corner hoops at a steady 3 m. Keep your line straight and your height level on every leg.

steps.text: Take off and climb to 3 m
Fly left to the first corner
Fly away to the far-left corner
Fly across to the far-right corner
Fly back toward you to the last corner
Return to the start and hold
Land back on the pad

name: Precision landing
brief: Fly out to the far pad and land right on the centre. Distance is hard to judge from where you stand.

steps.text: Take off and climb to 4 m
Fly over to the far pad
Land on the centre of the pad

name: Figure eight
brief: Fly a figure eight around the two poles at 4 m, through each hoop in order.

steps.text: Take off and climb to 4 m
Fly to the crossing point
Loop round the left pole
Loop round the right pole
Land back on the pad

name: Orbit
brief: Circle the pole at 10 m radius and 5 m height, like filming a point of interest.

steps.text: Take off and climb to 5 m
Fly to the near side of the circle
Orbit the pole
Land back on the pad

name: Attitude mode in wind
brief: No GPS hold and a gusty 4 m/s crosswind: the drone drifts unless you correct. Use small, early stick inputs.

steps.text: Take off and climb to 3 m
Hold in the ring against the wind
Land back on the pad
